results.title: The whole WORM directory removed while the instance runs
results.evidence: the entire anchor root was removed and the next anchor recreated it (/tmp/maya-qa-sjtc7p8l/data/worm) and wrote seq 13 into it, reporting written=1. `FilesystemWORM.put` opens with `root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`, so a store that has vanished is repaired rather than reported. Every earlier anchor is gone, the new one agrees with the chain, and `verify_against_anchors` now reports a chain
